=======================================
Await applies to a parenthesized callee chain
=======================================

async function f() {
  const a = await (x ?? y)(z);
  const b = await (await fetch(u)).json();
}

---

(program
  (function_declaration
    name: (identifier)
    parameters: (formal_parameters)
    body: (statement_block
      (lexical_declaration
        (variable_declarator
          name: (identifier)
          value: (await_expression
            (call_expression
              function: (parenthesized_expression
                (binary_expression
                  left: (identifier)
                  right: (identifier)))
              arguments: (arguments
                (identifier))))))
      (lexical_declaration
        (variable_declarator
          name: (identifier)
          value: (await_expression
            (call_expression
              function: (member_expression
                object: (parenthesized_expression
                  (await_expression
                    (call_expression
                      function: (identifier)
                      arguments: (arguments
                        (identifier)))))
                property: (property_identifier))
              arguments: (arguments))))))))
